(South Africa)|Dynamos]] | relegated = | matches = | total goals = | prevseason = [[2000–01 National First Division|2000–01]] | nextseason = [[2002–03 National First Division|2002–03]] }} The '''2001–02 National First Division''' was the 6th season of [[National First Division|the second tier]] of South African [[Association football|soccer]] since the reorganisation in 1996. It consisted of two streams, an Inland stream of 16 teams, and a Coastal stream of 14 teams. The Coastal stream was won by [[African Wanderers F.C.|African Wanderers]]{{Cite web |date=1 Feb 2019 |title=PSL clubs since 1994 |url=https://www.pressreader.com/south-africa/kick-off/20190201/281599536706176 |access-date=2023-08-17 |website=Kick Off |via=PressReader}} and the Inland stream by [[Dynamos F.C. (South Africa)|Dynamos]], with both earning promotion to the [[2002–03 Premier Soccer League]]. Two seasons after setting a number of records for worst performing team in the Premier Division, [[Mother City F.C.|Mother City]] were relegated from the Coastal Stream, finishing bottom.{{Cite web |date=2021-10-22 |title=HISTORY: The PSL from 1996 to 2002 – FARPost |url=https://farpost.co.za/history-the-psl-from-1996-to-2002/ |access-date=2023-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211022043804/https://farpost.co.za/history-the-psl-from-1996-to-2002/ |archive-date=22 October 2021 }} == Bribery allegations == The manager of promotion-chasing [[Avendale Athletico]], Trevor Heinrich, along with the coach, David Byrne, claimed to have been approached shortly before the club's game against William Pescod by a man offering that he could arrange for the game to go their way, for [[South African rand|R]]6,000. The man claimed that another club, also in the promotion race, had offered the referee R4,500. Avendale refused the offer, and the game was drawn 1-1, with Avendale having a goal disallowed in the last minute.{{Cite web |date=2002-03-21 |title=New soccer bribe claim |url=https://www.iol.co.za/capeargus/sport/new-soccer-bribe-claim-508523 |access-date=2023-09-07 |website=IOL}} League winners Wanderers defeated [[Avendale Athletico]] 1–0 in another key game, with a goal controversially disallowed amongst allegations of bribery and corruption.{{Cite web |title=About the NFD |url=https://www.psl.co.za/content/16306 |access-date=2023-08-17 |website=www.psl.co.za}}
